proposal.summary: Unquoted service path for ASUSTeK Aura Ready Game SDK service (GameSDK.exe) 1.0.0.4 could allow a local user to escalate privileges by creating a malicious %PROGRAMFILES(X86)%\ASUS\GameSDK.exe file.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the service ImagePath contains unquoted spaces on a vulnerable system; if confirmed, update the service to use a fully quoted path and restrict write permissions on the directory.
